changes.text: Fixed description on Integration and Instant Healing (they incorrectly stated they cannot be used at the same time, but they can). (This is a text change only, powers are unchanged).
Striga Isle: Fixed Archon Parson in Lars Hansen's second to last miss mission to spawn at an appropriate level (was spawning far too low level).
Fixed small typos and other text problems in several missions.
Portal Corp: Infernal will once again spawn correctly in his mission. The final room of this mission will now appear correctly in the overhead minimap.
